column1: # inc-jw0hw: the expected light of every effect in the effect reel, from the
# rulings in the bead notes (bd show inc-jw0hw, NOTES, 2026-11-16..18).
# Read by tools/check_effect_light_table.sh (glow, color) and the reel (shows_nothing).
# effect: full effect name as declared, with its ;tag (unique key).
# glow: LIT or UNLIT. An UNLIT effect still draws its glyphs.
# color: for LIT rows: a damage-type class (fire cold elec light silvery magic
#   rainbow necro disint), cval:<COLOR> (the plain cval, lightened), or a corrected color the data must gain
# shows_nothing: yes only where a ruling says the effect shows nothing.
# basis: R<date> = ruling of that date in the bead notes; otherwise the principle used.
# Not here: Pyrotechnics;smoke (not a reel effect; ruled UNLIT) and the 9 REEL_SKIP effects.
